ctx.x: So I went with Benny for that show and it lasted over a year, I guess it was, about a year, because the feature stars in it on stage were Beatrice Lily and Bert Lahr, and it was quite a musical event because Stravinsky composed the music for the ballet duo of Alicia Markova and Anton Dolan -- they did a special two person dance, a pas de deux, with original music composed by Igor Stravinsky, and the overture to the second act was composed by
William Shuman who was then on the way to becoming the new young President of Juilliard, and now he's President of Lincoln Center.
